segment_repairs.en_tex:
Now for down:

\begin{center}
\begin{adjustbox}{max width=\linewidth}\begin{tabular}{ | r | c | c | }
\hline
 & Left & Right \\
\hline
Down & \(2, ?\) & \(1, ?\) \\
\hline
\end{tabular}\end{adjustbox}
\end{center}

Here, he earns 2 with probability \(\sigma_{\text{left}}\) and 1 with probability \(1-\sigma_{\text{left}}\), or:

\[
\begin{aligned}
\mathrm{EU}_{\text{down}} &= \sigma_{\text{left}}(2)+(1-\sigma_{\text{left}})(1)
\end{aligned}
\]

Combining these together yields the following:

\[
\begin{aligned}
\mathrm{EU}_{\text{up}} &= \mathrm{EU}_{\text{down}} \\
\mathrm{EU}_{\text{up}} &= \sigma_{\text{left}}(3)+(1-\sigma_{\text{left}})(0) \\
\mathrm{EU}_{\text{down}} &= \sigma_{\text{left}}(2)+(1-\sigma_{\text{left}})(1) \\
\sigma_{\text{left}}(3)+(1-\sigma_{\text{left}})(0) &= \sigma_{\text{left}}(2)+(1-\sigma_{\text{left}})(1) \\
3\sigma_{\text{left}} &= \sigma_{\text{left}}+1 \\
2\sigma_{\text{left}} &= 1 \\
\sigma_{\text{left}} &= \frac12
\end{aligned}
\]
segment_repairs.ja_tex:
次に、下を選ぶ場合を考える。

\begin{center}
\begin{adjustbox}{max width=\linewidth}\begin{tabular}{ | r | c | c | }
\hline

\hline
下 & \(2, ?\) & \(1, ?\) \\
\hline
\end{tabular}\end{adjustbox}
\end{center}

ここで、プレイヤー1は確率 \(\sigma_{\text{left}}\) で2を、確率 \(1-\sigma_{\text{left}}\) で1を得る。すなわち、

\[
\begin{aligned}
\mathrm{EU}_{\text{down}} &= \sigma_{\text{left}}(2)+(1-\sigma_{\text{left}})(1)
\end{aligned}
\]

これらをまとめると、次のようになる。

\[
\begin{aligned}
\mathrm{EU}_{\text{up}} &= \mathrm{EU}_{\text{down}} \\
\mathrm{EU}_{\text{up}} &= \sigma_{\text{left}}(3)+(1-\sigma_{\text{left}})(0) \\
\mathrm{EU}_{\text{down}} &= \sigma_{\text{left}}(2)+(1-\sigma_{\text{left}})(1) \\
\sigma_{\text{left}}(3)+(1-\sigma_{\text{left}})(0) &= \sigma_{\text{left}}(2)+(1-\sigma_{\text{left}})(1) \\
3\sigma_{\text{left}} &= \sigma_{\text{left}}+1 \\
2\sigma_{\text{left}} &= 1 \\
\sigma_{\text{left}} &= \frac12
\end{aligned}
\]

segment_repairs.en_tex:
Next, we need to find her expected utility for right against that same mixed strategy:

\begin{center}
\begin{adjustbox}{max width=\linewidth}\begin{tabular}{ | r | c | }
\hline
 & Right \\
\hline
Up & \(?, 1\) \\
Down & \(?, -1\) \\
\hline
\end{tabular}\end{adjustbox}
\end{center}

Here, she earns 1 with probability \(\sigma_{\text{up}}\) and -1 with probability \(1-\sigma_{\text{up}}\). As an equation:

\[
\begin{aligned}
\mathrm{EU}_{\text{right}} &= \sigma_{\text{up}}(1)+(1-\sigma_{\text{up}})(-1)
\end{aligned}
\]

To finish, we set the expected utility for left equal to the expected utility for right and solve for \(\sigma_{\text{up}}\):

\[
\begin{aligned}
\mathrm{EU}_{\text{left}} &= \mathrm{EU}_{\text{right}} \\
\sigma_{\text{up}}(-1)+(1-\sigma_{\text{up}})(2) &= \sigma_{\text{up}}(1)+(1-\sigma_{\text{up}})(-1) \\
-3\sigma_{\text{up}}+2 &= 2\sigma_{\text{up}}-1 \\
5\sigma_{\text{up}} &= 3 \\
\sigma_{\text{up}} &= \frac35
\end{aligned}
\]

So player 1 picks up with probability \(3/5\) and down with probability \(2/5\) in the MSNE.
segment_repairs.ja_tex:
次に、同じ混合戦略に対して、彼女が右を選んだ場合の期待効用を求める。

\begin{center}
\begin{adjustbox}{max width=\linewidth}\begin{tabular}{ | r | c | }
\hline
 & 右 \\
\hline
上 & \(?, 1\) \\
下 & \(?, -1\) \\
\hline
\end{tabular}\end{adjustbox}
\end{center}

ここでは、彼女は確率 \(\sigma_{\text{up}}\) で1を、確率 \(1-\sigma_{\text{up}}\) で-1を得る。式で表すと次のようになる。

\[
\begin{aligned}
\mathrm{EU}_{\text{right}} &= \sigma_{\text{up}}(1)+(1-\sigma_{\text{up}})(-1)
\end{aligned}
\]

最後に、左と右の期待効用を等しいと置き、\(\sigma_{\text{up}}\) について解く。

\[
\begin{aligned}
\mathrm{EU}_{\text{left}} &= \mathrm{EU}_{\text{right}} \\
\sigma_{\text{up}}(-1)+(1-\sigma_{\text{up}})(2) &= \sigma_{\text{up}}(1)+(1-\sigma_{\text{up}})(-1) \\
-3\sigma_{\text{up}}+2 &= 2\sigma_{\text{up}}-1 \\
5\sigma_{\text{up}} &= 3 \\
\sigma_{\text{up}} &= \frac35
\end{aligned}
\]

したがって、MSNEではプレイヤー1は確率 \(3/5\) で上を、確率 \(2/5\) で下を選ぶ。

segment_repairs.en_tex:
Now we match those probabilities with player 1's payoffs for each of the outcomes:

\begin{center}
\begin{adjustbox}{max width=\linewidth}\begin{tabular}{ | r | c | c | }
\hline
 & Left & Right \\
\hline
Up & \(3, ?\) & \(-1, ?\) \\
Down & \(-1, ?\) & \(2, ?\) \\
\hline
\end{tabular}\end{adjustbox}
\end{center}

We now combine this information together as a formula:

\[
\begin{aligned}
\mathrm{EU}_1 &= \frac35\frac37(3)+\frac25\frac37(-1)+\frac35\frac47(-1)+\frac25\frac47(2) \\
&= \frac9{35}(3)+\frac6{35}(-1)+\frac{12}{35}(-1)+\frac8{35}(2) \\
&= \frac{27}{35}-\frac6{35}-\frac{12}{35}+\frac{16}{35} \\
&= \frac{25}{35}=\frac57
\end{aligned}
\]

And, sure enough, his expected utility of \(5/7\) in the MSNE is better than the 0 he would receive for middle as a pure strategy.
segment_repairs.ja_tex:
次に、これらの確率を、それぞれの結果におけるプレイヤー1の利得と対応させる。

\begin{center}
\begin{adjustbox}{max width=\linewidth}\begin{tabular}{ | r | c | c | }
\hline
 & 左 & 右 \\
\hline
上 & \(3, ?\) & \(-1, ?\) \\
下 & \(-1, ?\) & \(2, ?\) \\
\hline
\end{tabular}\end{adjustbox}
\end{center}

この情報をまとめて数式にすると、次のようになる。

\[
\begin{aligned}
\mathrm{EU}_1 &= \frac35\frac37(3)+\frac25\frac37(-1)+\frac35\frac47(-1)+\frac25\frac47(2) \\
&= \frac9{35}(3)+\frac6{35}(-1)+\frac{12}{35}(-1)+\frac8{35}(2) \\
&= \frac{27}{35}-\frac6{35}-\frac{12}{35}+\frac{16}{35} \\
&= \frac{25}{35}=\frac57
\end{aligned}
\]

予想どおり、MSNEにおける期待効用 \(5/7\) は、純粋戦略として中央を選んだ場合の0より大きい。
